item.summary: fix(ui): zone writes during startup no longer erase persisted Workboard pins (#123475) The reconciler dropped workboard entries from the canonical persisted list whenever workboardEnabled was false — but enablement reads as disabled until the runtime config snapshot loads, so any pin/unpin/drag in that window permanently deleted every workboard pin from synced prefs. The boards-not- ready branch already preserved slots for exactly this ambiguity; disabled now folds into it. Prod net −1.
